## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.5

This release separates GUI responsibilities while preserving the appearance and gameplay behavior of v1.1.4.

### Added

- Added `GuiControls` for panel, element and navigation buttons.
- Added `GuiDrawing` for shared pixel-snapped surfaces and borders.
- Added `FlyingCard` as a separate presentation-only animation state class.
- Added documentation of the refactoring scope and validation.

### Fixed

- No gameplay fixes are introduced in this release; the changes reorganize the existing GUI implementation.

### Other

- Reduced `CardsGuiScreen` from 1,240 to 1,023 lines while retaining screen lifecycle, layout, input, inventory and network dispatch.
- Preserved the remaining screen method bodies and extracted implementations, apart from visibility and enclosing-class changes.
- Kept purchases, awakening, search, server logic, MongoDB, fonts, textures and blur ownership unchanged.
- Passed the local clean build, inventory/catalog regression checks and feature, develop, main and tag CI builds.
- Verified the published JAR, version metadata and extracted classes.
- Manual Minecraft testing was confirmed by the user after publication.
- README screenshots remain explicitly labelled v1.1.4.

### Download

Use the attached `customguimod-1.1.5.jar`. The client and server must use the same mod version.

Required resource pack:
[RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

Choose either:

- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip`
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip`

**Full Changelog:** [v1.1.4...v1.1.5](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.1.4...v1.1.5)
